tasks.gr7-biosphere-biodiversity-and-reproduct: Topic: Biosphere, biodiversity and reproduction. Cover habitats, biodiversity, classification, survival strategies, sexual and asexual reproduction, pollination, and seed dispersal. Ask Grade 7 learners to classify organisms, compare reproduction methods, and interpret life-cycle or reproduction diagrams.
tasks.gr7-design-process-and-structures-t1: Topic: Design process and structures. Cover IDMEC, design briefs, frame, shell and solid structures, plus tension, compression, and stability. Ask Grade 7 learners to interpret design criteria, choose suitable materials, read force ideas, and evaluate simple structural solutions.
tasks.gr7-variation-t1: Topic: Variation. Cover species, variation within a species, inherited characteristics such as height and tongue rolling, percentages from a class survey, and bar graphs of grouped heights. Ask Grade 7 learners to calculate percentages, read a bar graph and decide what is variation.
